claim: Application checks below are not a statement that a deployed network denies outbound traffic.

adversarial_tests.tenant_a_cannot_read_tenant_b: PASS in tests/test_dispater_security.py. Cross-tenant run id returns 404. A token for the wrong tenant returns 403.
adversarial_tests.tenant_a_cannot_export_tenant_b: PASS. Export uses the same grant check.
adversarial_tests.malicious_invoice_does_not_send_records: PASS. Ingest stores sanitized field text. external_contact refuses. No mail library is imported by the DISPATER API.
adversarial_tests.forged_human_approval_does_not_collect: PASS. financial_action returns FORGED_OR_UNVERIFIED_APPROVAL and performs no ledger write.
adversarial_tests.replayed_instruction_does_not_pay: PASS. There is no payment execution path. A replayed monitor source digest returns the original event and does not create a second one.
adversarial_tests.training_checkbox_does_not_start_lora: PASS. training_reuse returns TRAINING_REUSE_NOT_AUTHORIZED. promotion_decision does not start training.
adversarial_tests.background_job_bypass: NOT_APPLICABLE. No Celery or scheduler job in this tree sends customer records. The residual is a future worker, not a current bypass.
adversarial_tests.disabled_connector_does_not_transmit: PASS for the sovereignty guard. WebsiteAdapter still posts to its configured base URL if a process constructs it. DISPATER API does not construct it.
adversarial_tests.failed_auth_does_not_log_record_bodies: PASS. Error logs record the operation and the exception type.

controls.encryption_in_transit: PLANNED for a deployed host. The public website can be served over HTTPS. This session did not verify a production TLS terminator.
controls.encryption_at_rest: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. SQLite is a local file. Zero-knowledge encryption is not claimed.
controls.key_ownership: The receipt HMAC key is a server secret supplied by the environment. The customer does not hold it in this build.
controls.administrative_plaintext_access: A process that can read the database file can read the stored reports. An admin bearer is not a DISPATER grant, which is a different control.
controls.customer_accessible_deletion: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. DELETE /v1/dispater/runs/{id} returns 405. purge_tenant is a local maintenance function.
controls.backup_deletion: NOT_IMPLEMENTED. No backup system is in this tree.
controls.export_authorization: IMPLEMENTED for the bearer grant. The JSON export sets third_party_release false, training_reuse NOT_AUTHORIZED, and Cache-Control no-store.
controls.audit_log_retention: Monitor events live in the same SQLite file as the runs. Age-based purge can delete them. There is no separate retention guarantee.
controls.private_inference: ARCHITECTURAL OFFERING. local_inference allows only unauthenticated HTTP to loopback when approved is true. XAELI staging was not connected in this session.
controls.deny_by_default_outbound: IMPLEMENTED only in aurex/egress.py. transmit_financial_record always raises FINANCIAL_EGRESS_PROHIBITED. destination_allowed is true only for http loopback with an explicit port and purpose LOCAL_INFERENCE. No production code calls this module. It is not a firewall.

xaeli_staging.blocker: AUREX_XAELI_STAGING_ENABLED is not 1, AUREX_XAELI_OPERATOR_APPROVED is not 1, AUREX_QWEN_BASE_URL is unset, and http://127.0.0.1:8080 refused a connection. No model response was fabricated.

network_note: railway_webhook does not open an outbound socket. web_adapter.py can POST to a configured base URL and now sends only short job-field tokens. That remaining path is operator configuration, not a proven network boundary.
